messages:
laura: quick check — after the tenant consolidation yesterday i'm seeing a ~6-8% drop in prefix-cache hitrate on nodepool-b. happened around 03:20 UTC. could this be multi-tenant noise evicting hot prefixes?

sandeep: hmm, do we have the per-tenant keyspace heatmap for that window? might be a tenant with very bursty long-seqs.

matt: i pulled the sample: `grep 'nodepool-b' /var/log/prefixcache/evictions.log | sed -n '03100,03140p'` gave a spike of evictions at 03:19:42 — mostly short prefixes with ~payload_size 12-48.

laura: ok — my hypothesis: a few tenants started using long-context chat sessions which cause many transient prefixes that thrash slot buckets. if buckets are imbalanced, eviction noise moves hot prefixes out.

jessica: can we repro in benchmark cluster? i can run a mixed-tenant workload: 80% steady queries + 20% long-chats ramp. want me to run with throttling on migration?

sandeep: yes please. use the existing harness `tools/bench/prefix_noise.py` with flags: `--tenants=50 --burst-tenant=5 --burst-rate=200 --duration=600`. also enable `--sample-evict=true` so we can capture prefix lineage.

matt: posted a small synthetic job: https://ci.internal/jobs/2742 — it runs the bench + collects `kv_metrics` histograms. initial run shows hitrate drop 7.3% under burst. attaching the two-line config i used:

```
# bench config
tenants: 50
burst_tenants: [12,33,47]
burst_profile: long_chat
batch_size: 16
```

laura: perfect. if the bench reproduces, next step is to try: 1) per-tenant reservation on hot slots 2) degrade long-chat TTL to reduce transient prefixes 3) tweak segment migration throttle. which should we try first?

jessica: i'd try TTL tuning first (least invasive) then segment migration throttle. per-tenant reservation needs infra changes.

sandeep: agree. also add a short experiment toggling `compact_on_eviction=true` to see if aggressive compaction reduces fragmentation under burst.

ci-bot: build #2742 finished: bench run SUCCESS (log: https://ci.internal/artifacts/2742/logs/bench.log). summary: baseline hitrate 88.9% -> burst 81.6%, eviction rate x6.

matt: ok that's a clear signal. i'm going to capture a heap snapshot + slot distribution at peak and share soon. tagging @eng-runtime for visibility. :mag:

laura: thanks all — if you post the heap/slot dump i'll open a tiny RFC for TTL change + compaction flag flip. prefer low-risk ops that we can rollback quickly.

sandeep: +1. i'll also add a lightweight metric: top10 tenant eviction contribution so we can alert if a single tenant crosses threshold.

laura: sweet. i'll follow up with the RFC. closing this thread for now but leave notes in the RFC for reproducer steps. :thumbsup:
